author: PavelMakarchuk
body: Fix PR up: **PolicyEngine/policyengine-us#8874** (Fixes #8649). AZ Form 140PTC now uses Table 2 for married/cohabitating filers (ARS §43-1072(A)(3)) via a local table-selection fix (avoided flipping the global `cohabitating_spouses` default). Verified $78 → **$323**; 468 AZ tests pass.
